verdict.rationale: Hardware-accelerator support is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows llama.cpp/Apple MLX engines and a GPU offload flag (`--gpu`). Nothing documents TPU or Gaudi support, or any plugin mechanism for adding accelerator backends. The community mention of "plugins like RAG" is an unrelated feature and does not count.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run inference on specialized accelerators like TPUs or Gaudi through plugin support
